fields.label: NUTS code
fields.description: NUTS 2024 code of the region.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: Name of the NUTS 3 region (Latin script).

fields.label: Country
fields.description: Country code of the region.

fields.label: Population
fields.description: Population on 1 January (Eurostat demo_r_pjanaggr3).

fields.label: Area
fields.description: Area of the region: the sum of its local administrative units' areas (GISCO LAU 2021).

fields.label: Density
fields.description: Population ÷ area.

fields.label: GDP
fields.description: Gross domestic product at current prices (Eurostat nama_10r_3gdp).

fields.label: Jobs
fields.description: Employment at the place of work (Eurostat nama_10r_3empers).

fields.label: Growth
fields.description: Change in the region's population between 1 January 2020 and 1 January 2025 (Eurostat demo_r_pjanaggr3, NUTS 3). A change beyond ±15% is a break in the series (a census revision), left blank. United Kingdom: ONS, NRS and NISRA figures for its ITL regions.

fields.label: Median age
fields.description: Median age of the region's residents on 1 January (Eurostat demo_r_pjanind3, NUTS 3). United Kingdom: ONS, NRS and NISRA figures for its ITL regions.

fields.label: Seniors
fields.description: Share of the region's residents aged 65 or over on 1 January (Eurostat demo_r_pjanaggr3, NUTS 3). United Kingdom: ONS, NRS and NISRA figures for its ITL regions.

fields.label: Children
fields.description: Share of the region's residents under 15 on 1 January (Eurostat demo_r_pjanaggr3, NUTS 3). United Kingdom: ONS, NRS and NISRA figures for its ITL regions.

fields.label: GDP per person (PPS)
fields.description: Gross domestic product per inhabitant in purchasing power standards (PPS, EU27 = euros at average EU prices), so price levels are comparable across countries (Eurostat nama_10r_3gdp, NUTS 3). A region without a figure takes its larger region's; Iceland and Bosnia and Herzegovina, which publish no regional figure, the national accounts' (nama_10_pc), and Switzerland its PPS volume index times the EU level. Kosovo and Liechtenstein have none. United Kingdom: ONS, NRS and NISRA figures for its ITL regions.

fields.label: Household income (PPS)
fields.description: Net disposable income of private households per inhabitant, in purchasing power standards (Eurostat nama_10r_2hhinc, NUTS 2): what households have left to spend or save after taxes and with social transfers. Iceland, Switzerland, Albania, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Serbia and Kosovo publish no such account: their national figure is estimated from the EU-SILC survey's mean income, times the median ratio between the two measures in the countries that have both. Bosnia and Herzegovina and Liechtenstein have none. United Kingdom: gross disposable household income per head (ONS), a little above the net measure.

fields.label: Poverty
fields.unit: at risk of poverty or social exclusion
fields.description: Share of people at risk of poverty or social exclusion (AROPE: below 60% of the national median income, severely deprived, or in a household with very low work intensity), Eurostat ilc_peps11n, NUTS 2. The poverty line is national, so the rate compares people with their own country. The United Kingdom publishes no regional rate on this definition: blank.

fields.label: Unemployment
fields.description: Unemployment rate, ILO definition, ages 15-74 (Eurostat lfst_r_lfu3rt, labour force survey, NUTS 2). United Kingdom: Annual Population Survey, ages 16 and over.

fields.label: Employment rate
fields.description: Share of people aged 20-64 in employment (Eurostat lfst_r_lfe2emprt, NUTS 2). United Kingdom: Annual Population Survey, ages 16-64.

fields.label: University degrees
fields.description: Share of people aged 25-64 with tertiary education, ISCED levels 5-8 (Eurostat edat_lfse_04, NUTS 2). United Kingdom: Annual Population Survey, qualifications at level 4 or above, ages 16-64.

fields.label: Life expectancy
fields.description: Life expectancy at birth, both sexes (Eurostat demo_r_mlifexp, NUTS 2, latest year published). United Kingdom: the mean of men's and women's life expectancy by local area (ONS).

fields.label: Forest
fields.description: Share of the region's land covered by forest (CORINE 311-313), mean over the sample points of the hexes that fall in the region.

fields.label: Cropland
fields.description: Share of the region's land in crops, vineyards and orchards (CORINE 211-223, 241), mean over the sample points of the hexes that fall in the region.

fields.label: Pasture
fields.description: Share of the region's land in pastures and mixed farming (CORINE 231, 242-244), mean over the sample points of the hexes that fall in the region.

fields.label: Built-up
fields.description: Share of the region's built-up land (CORINE 111-133), mean over the sample points of the hexes that fall in the region.

fields.label: Urban area
fields.description: The urban area (cities.json id) holding most of the region's people, if any.

fields.label: Hex
fields.description: A representative hex of the region.

fields.label: Estimated
fields.description: Figures filled from a larger region because Eurostat does not publish them for this one (tables: emp3 = jobs by branch, gva3 = value added by branch, gdp3 = GDP, pop3 = population).
